title: Le Creuset – Cast iron skillet 16 cm – Vintage model
description:
Vintage 16 cm cast iron skillet with pouring spouts (“becs verseurs”). Ideal for small portions, such as a single fried egg.
Features a classic vintage shape and solid construction.
Shows signs of use consistent with age, adding to its authentic charm. Please refer to the photos for the exact condition, as they are part of the description.
